text:
Priya S: quick sync on CloudScale marketplace + SI kickoff. need a tight checklist for launch day and the embargo schedule. who can take landing page, partner blog, and press ops?
Liam H: I can own the partner blog + SI integration guide. will draft a runbook for systems integrators (how to wire billing + VPC). target draft by Wed EOD.
Kira M: design will produce marketplace card + three responsive screenshots. ETA Thu 11:00 PT. will need co-logo SVGs and final alt text.
CloudScale PM: Arun here. partner legal wants co-brand usage guidelines and a 48h review window. we can sign by Nov 5 if you push docs today.
Marcos PR: proposed embargo window: 2028-11-08 08:00 PT. plan: one-hour exclusive to InfraWorld, then full wire. want to coordinate an embargoed analyst briefing the day before.
OpsBot: Reminder: upload checklist to /shared/partnerships/cloudscale/checklist.md. Missing items: marketplace tile, integration templates, demo script.
Priya S: landing copy needs two CTAs: "Deploy on CloudScale" and "Read SI guide". please add UTM strings to both. also need a short partner quote from Arun by Nov 3 COB.
Liam H: sample SI guide metadata (for marketplace):
```
product: "Redwood Inference for CloudScale"
sku: "rw-inference-cloudscale-1"
regions: "us-west-2,eu-central-1"
pricing_model: "marketplace_metered"
```
We'll include a quickstart and terraform template.
Kira M: question: CloudScale accepts 1:1 aspect ratio for cards. who can generate a clean 1200x1200 hero?
Priya S: I can produce a clean hero from our demo cluster tomorrow morning. tag me for edits.
Marcos PR: timeline proposal: Nov 5 final assets, Nov 6 partner legal sign-off, Nov 7 embargoed send to press, Nov 8 public launch. need CEO quote by Nov 4.
CloudScale PM: partner will pre-approve technical copy but needs to review marketing blurbs. we'll aim for Nov 6 review.
Priya S: analytics: add UTM: utm_source=cloudscale_marketplace&utm_medium=partner_listing&utm_campaign=cloudscale_q4. Also want to track signups -> add event marketplace_click and deploy_started.
Liam H: I'll wire analytics events into the example deploy template.
Kira M: small ask 90 can PMs provide final logo zips (SVG + PNG) and alt text by EOD today?
OpsBot: Task assignments saved: Liam H -> partner-blog (due 1836086400), Kira M -> marketplace-assets (due 1836043200).
Marcos PR: PR detail: will prepare two versions of the release: (1) joint announcement with partner messaging, (2) Redwood-first angle for vertical outlets. will post both for approval here on Nov 6 morning.
Priya S: also planning a launch webinar for SI partners the afternoon of Nov 8. who can host product demo?
Liam H: I can demo the deploy flow and show monitoring. need a short runbook for slide deck.
CloudScale PM: we'll provide a customer case blurb and one performance slide.
Kira M: booking 90min design review tomorrow 3pm PT to align screenshots + card.
Priya S: final checklist from me: 
- [ ] hero + screenshots done
- [ ] co-logo & legal sign-off
- [ ] marketplace metadata + templates
- [ ] partner blog draft
- [ ] embargoed press release ready
- [ ] webinar slides + demo runbook
If any blockers tag @Priya S.
Marcos PR: will circulate embargo instructions to partner comms and schedule analyst briefing. cc pr@redwood.ai when you have approvals.
Priya S: thanks everyone. I'll keep updates here. leaving a pinned copy of the checklist in this thread.
